issuer: the South Dakota Department of Public Safety, Driver Licensing
note: South Dakota Codified Laws on sdlegislature.gov (read 2026-10-30): § 32-12-16 sets the application fee for an original or renewed licence at $38; § 32-12-42 has an operator's licence expire on the birthday in the fifth year after issue; § 32-12-17 issues an operator's licence to a minor from 16 who has been through the instruction permit and restricted minor's permit (§ 32-12-14.1 lifts the restricted permit's restrictions at 18, but they bind the permit, not the operator's licence), so it is held from 16. § 32-12-17.2 charges the same fees for a nondriver identification card, issued to any resident, expiring on the birthday in the fifth year after issue.

sources.title: SDCL 32-12-16, Fee for original, renewal, duplicate, or changed license
sources.said: The application fee for an original driver license or a renewal of a driver license is thirty-eight dollars.

sources.title: SDCL 32-12-42, Expiration of license or permit
sources.said: An operator's license, motorcycle operator's license, restricted minor's permit, or motorcycle restricted minor's permit expires on the licensee's birthday in the fifth year following the issuance of the license

sources.title: SDCL 32-12-17, Issuance of license
sources.said: An operator's license may be issued to a minor at least sixteen years of age but less than eighteen years of age

sources.title: SDCL 32-12-17.2, Nondriver identification cards
sources.said: the fees for a nondriver identification card are the same as prescribed for a driver license in § 32-12-16 ... Each nondriver identification card expires on the holder's birthday in the fifth year following the issuance of the nondriver identification card
